meta.description: Xiaomi's efficiency-balanced omnimodal MoE (309B total / 15B active) with hybrid attention, FP8-compute/mxfp4-stored weights, 1M context, and a DFlash speculative decoder — the default MOPD checkpoint fixes the RL release's tool-call repetition

  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --tool-call-parser mimo \

guide:
## Overview

This recipe serves the MiMo-V2.6-Flash family from two checkpoints on the
Variant row:

- **MOPD** (default) — [XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD),
  the MOPD2-distilled upgrade and the recommended starting point for new
  deployments. It fixes the RL release's most visible agentic failure mode —
  tool-call repetition, where the model keeps re-issuing the same or highly
  similar tool calls while making no progress (the blog measures the Flash
  line as the more affected of the two) — with benchmark quality unchanged,
  folded into a regular MOPD2 pass via a short specialized-teacher run
  ([diagnosis blog](https://mimo.xiaomi.com/blog/mimo-v2-6-tool-call-repetition)).
- **RL (original)** — [XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL),
  the 2026-09-22 RL release, kept for reproducing earlier results. It can get
  stuck re-issuing the same tool calls in agentic workloads; prefer **MOPD**
  unless you are reproducing a specific earlier run.

MOPD2 (Technical Report §5.6) is multi-teacher on-policy distillation:
domain-specialized mixRL and SFT teachers supervise the student on three
on-policy streams (standard MOPD, teacher-prefix OPD, and SFT-prefix OPD).

The architecture is shared by both checkpoints: a sparse MoE model with
309B total parameters and 15B active per token — 48 layers (1 dense + 47 MoE)
with 256 routed experts (top-8), hybrid attention (sliding-window 128 and
global attention), and a 5-layer DFlash-style MTP drafter that predicts 7
tokens per pass. The model is natively omnimodal (text, image, video, audio
via a 681M-param MiMo ViT and audio encoders) and supports up to 1M tokens of
context.

Weights are stored as mxfp4 and computed as FP8 (block-wise e4m3, 128x128),
so the checkpoint is only 173 GB on disk. Loading this mixed storage format
requires vLLM with the MiMo V2 mxfp4/bf16-router support
([vllm-project/vllm#57784](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57784)),
first shipped in the v0.31.0 stable release.

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: 4x H200 (TP4), 4x MI355X/MI325X/MI300X (TP4), or equivalent aggregate VRAM (>= 208 GB)

### Pull the vLLM docker image

vLLM 0.31.0 is the first stable release that can load the mxfp4-stored
weights ([vllm-project/vllm#57784](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57784));
earlier stable releases cannot:

```bash
docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0
```

MI300X / MI325X (gfx942) additionally need the MiMo MXFP4 routing gate
([vllm-project/vllm#58262](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58262)),
which merged after the v0.31.0 branch cut — on those GPUs use a nightly wheel
built after 2026-09-30 (`uv pip install -U vllm --extra-index-url
https://wheels.vllm.ai/nightly/cu130`) or the ROCm nightly image.

This release also registers the `mimo` tool-call and reasoning parsers with
the Rust frontend
([vllm-project/vllm#57933](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57933)).

The Hugging Face model cards point at `vllm/vllm-openai:mimov25-cu129`, the
V2.5-era image; that tag predates the mxfp4-stored-weight support linked above,
so use the v0.31.0 image recommended above.

## Launch command

Single-node TP4 (H200). Selecting the **RL (original)** variant in the builder
swaps only the checkpoint id (`XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL`); everything
else is identical:

```bash
vllm serve XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
  --max-model-len auto \
  --reasoning-parser mimo \
  --tool-call-parser mimo \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --generation-config vllm
```

### AMD (MI355X, gfx950)

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4 \
vllm serve XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-model-len auto \
  --reasoning-parser mimo \
  --tool-call-parser mimo \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --generation-config vllm
```

MI355X also runs TP2 just fine.

### AMD (MI300X / MI325X, gfx942)

gfx942 has no native MXFP4 MoE path: without an explicit backend vLLM's
oracle falls back to OCP emulation — correct, but about 6.5x lower output
throughput. Select AITER's Triton W4A16 kernel instead with
`--moe-backend aiter_triton_mxfp4_bf16`; supported since
[vllm-project/vllm#58262](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58262)
(merged 2026-09-30, after the v0.31.0 branch cut — not in any stable release
yet, so this flag needs a nightly wheel; it also needs aiter >= 0.1.20, which
the ROCm nightly image ships). Verified end-to-end on MI300X in that PR — see
it for the gsm8k and `vllm bench serve` numbers against the emulation
baseline:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4 \
vllm serve XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --max-model-len auto \
  --reasoning-parser mimo \
  --tool-call-parser mimo \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --moe-backend aiter_triton_mxfp4_bf16 \
  --generation-config vllm
```
With DFlash speculative decoding (drafter ships inside the checkpoint).
vLLM does not resolve a `<repo>/dflash` Hub subfolder as the draft model —
`model` must be a concrete local path to the `dflash/` directory inside the
downloaded snapshot. Resolve it per checkpoint (run `hf download
<checkpoint>` first if it is not cached yet):

```bash
# MOPD variant
DFLASH_DIR=$(ls -d ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--XiaomiMiMo--MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD/snapshots/*/dflash)
# RL (original) variant
# DFLASH_DIR=$(ls -d ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--XiaomiMiMo--MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL/snapshots/*/dflash)
echo "$DFLASH_DIR"
```

```bash
vllm serve XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
  --max-model-len auto \
  --speculative-config "{\"method\":\"dflash\",\"model\":\"$DFLASH_DIR\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":7}" \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
  --reasoning-parser mimo \
  --tool-call-parser mimo \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --generation-config vllm
```

The drafter inherits the target's tensor-parallel size by default. To pin it
explicitly, add `"draft_tensor_parallel_size": 4` to the speculative config
(useful if you want the draft on fewer GPUs than the target, or to silence
mis-detection on asymmetric topologies).

## Client Usage

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello MiMo!"}],
    "temperature": 1.0,
    "top_p": 0.95,
    "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": true}
  }'
```

Recommended sampling: `temperature=1.0`, `top_p=0.95`.
Set `"enable_thinking": false` (or omit the kwargs) to disable thinking mode.
